title: Spinach & Cheddar Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Melt butter in a pan and wilt the spinach.
Pour in the eggs and cook until almost set.
Add cheddar, fold, and serve.

title: Classic Scrambled Eggs on Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Cook in butter over low heat, stirring gently.
Spoon onto the toast.

title: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a large pan.
Scramble the eggs, then push them aside.
Add the cooked rice and fry for 3 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and sliced green onion.

title: Veggie Fried Rice
steps: Fry the garlic in oil for 30 seconds.
Add the vegetables and cook until hot.
Add the rice and fry for 3 minutes.
Push aside, scramble the egg, and mix in with soy sauce.

title: Garlic Butter Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Melt butter and gently cook the garlic.
Toss the drained pasta in the garlic butter.
Top with parmesan.

title: Tomato Basil Spaghetti
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water.
Cook the garlic in olive oil, then add the tomatoes.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Toss with the spaghetti and torn basil.

title: Pesto Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta.
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Toss the drained pasta with pesto and tomatoes.
Top with parmesan.

title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta.
Brown the sliced mushrooms in butter.
Add garlic, then the cream, and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in parmesan and toss with the pasta.

title: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water.
Drain and return to the pot with butter.
Add milk and cheddar and stir over low heat.
Cook until creamy.

title: Chicken & Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the chicken thinly.
Stir-fry the chicken in oil until cooked.
Add broccoli and garlic and cook 4 minutes.
Add soy sauce and serve over rice.

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Sear in butter for 6 minutes per side.
Add garlic and lemon juice to the pan.
Spoon the sauce over the chicken.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
steps: Shred the chicken.
Fill half of each tortilla with chicken and cheese.
Fold and toast in a dry pan until golden on both sides.
Serve with salsa.

title: Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Cover half a tortilla with cheese.
Fold and toast in a dry pan.
Flip once, until the cheese melts.
Serve with salsa.

title: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Warm the beans with cumin.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with beans and sliced avocado.
Top with salsa and a squeeze of lime.

title: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the beef in a pan.
Stir in taco seasoning with a splash of water.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, lettuce, and cheese.

title: Tuna Melt
steps: Mix the tuna with mayonnaise.
Spread on bread and top with cheese.
Toast in a pan or oven until the cheese melts.

title: Grilled Cheese & Tomato
steps: Butter the outside of two slices of bread.
Fill with cheese and sliced tomato.
Toast in a pan until golden on both sides.

title: Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon, salt, and pepper.
Fry the egg.
Spread the avocado and top with the egg.

title: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomato and mozzarella.
Layer them with basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle salt.

title: Greek Salad
steps: Chop the cucumber, tomato, and onion.
Toss with olive oil and oregano.
Crumble feta on top.

title: Chickpea Curry
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Stir in curry powder for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over rice.

title: Lentil Soup
steps: Dice the carrot, onion, and celery.
Soften them in oil.
Add lentils, broth, and cumin.
Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Tomato Soup
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in cream.

title: Roasted Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Cut the potatoes into chunks.
Toss with oil, garlic, rosemary, and salt.
Roast for 35 minutes, turning once.

title: Sheet Pan Sausage & Veggies
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Chop everything into bite-size pieces.
Toss with oil and paprika on a sheet pan.
Roast for 30 minutes.

title: Honey Garlic Salmon
steps: Mix honey, garlic, and soy sauce.
Sear the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes.
Flip and pour in the sauce.
Cook 3 more minutes and finish with lemon.

title: Garlic Shrimp
steps: Melt butter and cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side.
Finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley.

title: Tofu Teriyaki Bowl
steps: Press and cube the tofu.
Fry in oil until golden.
Steam the broccoli.
Toss tofu in teriyaki sauce and serve over rice with broccoli.

title: Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash the banana.
Whisk in egg, milk, and flour.
Cook spoonfuls in butter until bubbles form.
Flip and cook 1 more minute.

title: Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into a glass.
Layer granola and blueberries.
Drizzle with honey.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with peanut butter.
Top with sliced banana and a drizzle of honey.
